Data can only be inserted into existing collections
Collection must be released before dropping
Describe, List, Has operations are idempotent

state_constraints.assertion: Exactly one primary field per collection with type Int64 or VarChar

state_constraints.description: Collection must be loaded before search
Search requires collection to be loaded
state_constraints.assertion: collection MUST be loaded before search

state_constraints.description: Query requires collection to be loaded
state_constraints.assertion: collection MUST be loaded before query

state_constraints.description: Drop requires collection to be released
state_constraints.assertion: collection MUST be released before drop

state_constraints.description: Collection must have exactly one primary key
state_constraints.assertion: isPrimary MUST be true for exactly one field

state_constraints.description: Collection must be loaded before searching

assertions.expected_behavior: Returns 400 when invalid parameters, malformed requests
Returns 401 when missing or invalid authentication
Returns 404 when resource does not exist
Returns 422 when valid request but semantically incorrect
After load, search operations return results
After release, collection is unloaded from memory
Collection must be released before dropping
After creating a collection, it should be listed and describable
After inserting entities, they should be get-able by their IDs
After dropping a collection, it should not be found in list/describe/has operations

assertions.description: Collection must have exactly one primary key field
assertions.expected_behavior: Collection schema must contain exactly one field with is_primary=true

assertions.expected_behavior: Primary field dataType must be Int64 or VarChar

assertions.description: Collection must have at least one vector field
assertions.expected_behavior: Collection schema must contain at least one vector field (FLOAT_VECTOR, etc.)

assertions.description: Searching empty collection returns empty results

behavioral_contracts.expected_behavior: Collection transitions through states: created → loaded → searchable → released → dropped
Inserted entities should be immediately retrievable via Get operation

behavioral_contracts.description: Collection must be created before querying
behavioral_contracts.expected_behavior: Query returns empty result (no error) for newly created collection

behavioral_contracts.description: Collection must be deleted then not queryable
behavioral_contracts.expected_behavior: Query returns 404 error for dropped collection

behavioral_contracts.scenario: Collection operations must follow lifecycle order
behavioral_contracts.expected_behavior: Create before insert, load before search, release before drop
